story.title: Handmade by Freda
story.text: It started with a scarf for my husband. One hook, a little yarn, and I was hooked. Now I crochet every piece myself, here in the UAE — so no two ever turn out quite the same.

newsletter.title: First dibs
newsletter.text: Be the first to see new pieces and restocks. Just yarn news — never spam.

seo.description: Crafting Yarn by Freda — hand-crocheted plushies, bags, clothing and accessories. Handmade in the UAE, with love. Every stitch tells a story.
